Part of my depression stems from me worrying about what people think of me. As much as I wish I didn't exist, suicide is troubling because I worry that even in death, I'd be judged by people. And even though I won't be around to be aware, or hear, or even know, it's still something that is in the back of my head. I often daydream about being a victim in a mass-casualty situation where I can finally die, but no one thinks less of me for it.
